Agent Name: Coder  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: Coder made the first mistake by creating a Python script that relied heavily on OCR (PyTesseract) to extract chess positions from the image. This approach was flawed because OCR is not well-suited for interpreting chessboards, which contain complex visual patterns rather than simple text. The reliance on OCR introduced inaccuracies and ambiguities in the chessboard layout, ultimately preventing accurate extraction of the position needed to identify the winning move for Black. Coder should have considered alternative methods, such as using specialized chessboard recognition tools or directly identifying piece positions through image processing algorithms tailored for chessboards.
